items.title: Harold Christophe Interview, 1961-08-01
items.q: I think when Lee Collins was there. Yeah, yeah. David Jones was there. He was at that store when Lee Collins was there.

ctx.x: You know who he was working with? Did he have his own band those days when you took lessons, or what was he doing?

Well, yeah, he had played on the TikTok there, Professor David Jones, about in the 30s. I think when Lee Collins was there. Yeah, yeah. David Jones was there. He was at that store when Lee Collins was there.
He made some records then. I just went out there before about 1929, I guess. Yeah, around in that time.

items.title: Crescent City Crystals: Dave Bailey, Harold Christophe, Albert Delone, Sylvester Handy Interview, 1963-11-13
items.q: The interviewee mentions David Jones was 'with Lee Collins and him at the Osdorio' but does not state he personally played with or knew Lee Collins, only that he knows of the association via David Jones.

ctx.x: Born in New Orleans and the Trimmy.

Trimmy? Oh, I know. From Trimmy to the Rocky Green. Like London Avenue. 7-Watt, you know? What... Who taught you to play guitar? Now, who taught me how to play guitar? My father played guitar, you see? Yeah. But my first instrument, I used to pick up his guitar. Uh-huh. And all that harmony was right in my head. Yeah. Sure, I guess from listening to him, you pick up... Yeah, and definitely I would get beaten for fooling the guitar. Yeah. You know what I mean? Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. But then I started out on the…
